text_block_list.text: (Shaaaaa...)

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Rain. ...Rain, rain.
...It's coming down harder and harder, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
With a storm in the forecast...
training outdoors is out of the question, isn't it?

On this day, regions across the country
were hit by record-breaking stormy weather.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...I've got a bad feeling about this.
This stormy weather left heavy scars across various regions.
And in the URA Finals as well—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, fine! I'll go negotiate directly!
We will make this happen no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Even if you go, Chairwoman, that won't solve the problem!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san.
Um, actually—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The "URA Finals" might not be able to take place...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Racetrack courses have
'turf,' don't they?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"That turf is grown at only a select few designated farms
before being laid out across the course."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: "However, I just received word that the turf we were cultivating was completely devastated by the recent storm..."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "That is turf we had prepared specifically for holding the 'URA Finals.'"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Due to safety concerns,
the turf must always be replaced.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: However, if the replacement turf has been completely ruined...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, if it's only on the dirt course,
holding the race is possible, but—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I strictly refuse! That will not do!!
The "URA Finals" is a race meant to provide
an opportunity to every single Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—Indomitable!
I will make sure this event takes place no matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever betray the Umamusume who have worked so hard to get here,
or the fans who cheer for us?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"A place to shine for all Umamusume!"
Until that ambition is fulfilled... I will never stop!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, Chairwoman!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Chairwoman... What do you intend to do?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If it were your usual bold antics, it would be one thing...
I just hope you do not overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes... Ever since the day I met her, she has always acted rashly based on feelings alone...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Her mother, the former Chairwoman,
was a truly magnificent person."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Having been strongly requested to dedicate herself
not just domestically, but for Umamusume all over the world,
she has decided to relocate her base overseas.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Even so, the daughter was still young, and plans were being made to seek another successor for the Chairwoman, but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"At that time, that person... the daughter of the predecessor,
Yayoi Akikawa, spoke up herself."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With a grand speech that rivaled any adult,
Yayoi-san seized the position of current Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"That speech was truly... nothing short of magnificent.
Overwhelming knowledge paired with a crystal-clear vision—"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...And above all,
it was brimming with love for Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Of course, she looks like that,
and she has her wild and eccentric side.
However, her love for Umamusume is the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Even though that person conceived this new race
for the sake of every single Umamusume..."
choice_data_list: I really want us to hold it somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'll give it some thought as well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Please lend us your wisdom as well, Trainer...!

Will the URA Finals
truly be held without a hitch...?
